VAR today_day = DAY([_last_selected_date])
VAR today_month = MONTH([_last_selected_date])
VAR today_year = YEAR([_last_selected_date])

VAR last_date_yoy_ = DATE(today_year-1,today_month,today_day)
VAR last_date_qoq_ = 
    SWITCH(today_month,
        1, DATE(today_year-1,10,today_day),
        2, DATE(today_year-1,11,today_day),
        3, DATE(today_year-1,12,today_day),
        DATE(today_year,today_month-3,today_day)
    )
VAR last_date_mom_ = 
    SWITCH(today_month,
        1, DATE(today_year-1,12,today_day),
        DATE(today_year,today_month-1,today_day)
    )
VAR last_date_week_ = DATE(today_year,today_month,today_day-7)

VAR year_diff_2019_ = 2019 - today_year
VAR last_date_2019_ = DATE(today_year+year_diff_2019_,today_month,today_day)

RETURN
    SWITCH( SELECTEDVALUE(ms_benchmark_[compare_id],99),
        1, CALCULATE([_display_value], DATEADD(dim_date[Date],-1,MONTH), dim_date[Date]<=last_date_mom_),
        2, CALCULATE([_display_value], DATEADD(dim_date[Date],-1,YEAR), dim_date[Date]<=last_date_yoy_),
        3, CALCULATE([_display_value], DATEADD(dim_date[Date],year_diff_2019_,YEAR), dim_date[Date]<=last_date_2019_),
        4, CALCULATE([_display_value], DATEADD(dim_date[Date],-3,YEAR), dim_date[Date]<=last_date_yoy_),
        6, CALCULATE([_display_value], DATEADD(dim_date[Date],-3,MONTH), dim_date[Date]<=last_date_qoq_),
        7, CALCULATE([_display_value], DATEADD(dim_date[Date],-1,DAY)) ,    
        8, CALCULATE([_display_value], DATEADD(dim_date[Date],-7,DAY), dim_date[Date]<=last_date_week_),
        BLANK()
    )

VAR _isReferinRow =
    ISINSCOPE(dim_visit_referin[referin_name])

VAR _isGroupRow =
    ISINSCOPE(dim_visit_referin[mkt_referchannel_group])

VAR _current_group =
    SELECTEDVALUE(dim_visit_referin[mkt_referchannel_group])

VAR _isReferIn =
    _current_group = "Refer in"

-- current value
VAR _campusVisit =
    [_campus_visit]

-- total เฉพาะ Refer in (ตัด filter ทั้ง table แล้วใส่กลับ)
VAR _referinTotal =
    CALCULATE(
        [_campus_visit],
        REMOVEFILTERS(dim_visit_referin),
        KEEPFILTERS(
            dim_visit_referin[mkt_referchannel_group] = "Refer in"
        )
    )

-- total ทั้งหมด
VAR _grandTotal =
    CALCULATE(
        [_campus_visit],
        REMOVEFILTERS(dim_visit_referin)
    )

RETURN
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),

    -- row: referin_name แต่ไม่ใช่ Refer in → ซ่อน
    _isReferinRow && NOT _isReferIn, BLANK(),

    -- row: referin_name (ภายใต้ Refer in)
    _isReferinRow,
        DIVIDE(_campusVisit, _referinTotal),

    -- row: group แต่ไม่ใช่ Refer in → ซ่อน
    _isGroupRow && NOT _isReferIn, BLANK(),

    -- row: group = Refer in → % ของทั้งหมด
    _isGroupRow,
        DIVIDE(_referinTotal, _grandTotal),

    -- total level
    DIVIDE(_referinTotal, _grandTotal)
)

measures.[Expression]:
VAR today_day = DAY([_last_selected_date])
VAR today_week = DAY([_last_selected_date])
VAR today_month = MONTH([_last_selected_date])
VAR today_year = YEAR([_last_selected_date])

VAR last_date_yoy_ = DATE(today_year-1,today_month,today_day)
VAR last_date_y2y_ = DATE(today_year-2,today_month,today_day)
VAR last_date_week_ = DATE(today_year,today_month,today_day-7)
VAR last_date_day_ = DATE(today_year,today_month,today_day-1)

VAR last_date_mom_ = 
    SWITCH(today_month,
        1, DATE(today_year-1,12,today_day),
        DATE(today_year,today_month-1,today_day)
    )
VAR last_date_qoq_ = 
    SWITCH(today_month,
        1, DATE(today_year-1,10,today_day),
        2, DATE(today_year-1,11,today_day),
        3, DATE(today_year-1,12,today_day),
        DATE(today_year,today_month-3,today_day)
    )
VAR _2021dec = CALCULATE([_display_value], ALL(dim_date), dim_date[Date] >= DATE(2021,12,1), dim_date[Date] <= DATE(2021,12,31)) /31
VAR _2019q4 = CALCULATE([_display_value], ALL(dim_date), dim_date[Date] >= DATE(2019,10,1), dim_date[Date] <= DATE(2019,12,31)) / 92
VAR _2020q4 = CALCULATE([_display_value], ALL(dim_date), dim_date[Date] >= DATE(2020,10,1), dim_date[Date] <= DATE(2020,12,31)) / 92
VAR _2021q4 = CALCULATE([_display_value], ALL(dim_date), dim_date[Date] >= DATE(2021,10,1), dim_date[Date] <= DATE(2021,12,31)) / 92
VAR _2021q3 = CALCULATE([_display_value], ALL(dim_date), dim_date[Date] >= DATE(2021,6,1), dim_date[Date] <= DATE(2021,9,31)) / 92
VAR _2021q2 = CALCULATE([_display_value], ALL(dim_date), dim_date[Date] >= DATE(2021,3,1), dim_date[Date] <= DATE(2021,6,31)) / 91
VAR _2021q1 = CALCULATE([_display_value], ALL(dim_date), dim_date[Date] >= DATE(2021,1,1), dim_date[Date] <= DATE(2021,3,31)) / 90

VAR _2021jan = CALCULATE([_display_value], ALL(dim_date), dim_date[Date] >= DATE(2021,1,1), dim_date[Date] <= DATE(2021,1,31)) / 31
VAR _2021feb = CALCULATE([_display_value], ALL(dim_date), dim_date[Date] >= DATE(2021,2,1), dim_date[Date] <= DATE(2021,2,28)) / 28



RETURN
    SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE(ms_benchmark[compare_id],99),
        1, CALCULATE([_display_value], DATEADD(dim_date[Date],-1,MONTH), dim_date[Date]<=last_date_mom_),
        2, CALCULATE([_display_value], DATEADD(dim_date[Date],-1,YEAR), dim_date[Date]<=last_date_yoy_),
        3, CALCULATE([_display_value], DATEADD(dim_date[Date],-2,YEAR), dim_date[Date]<=last_date_yoy_),
        4, CALCULATE([_display_value], DATEADD(dim_date[Date],-3,YEAR), dim_date[Date]<=last_date_yoy_),
        5, _2020q4 * DISTINCTCOUNT(dim_date[Date]),

        6, _2021dec * DISTINCTCOUNT(dim_date[Date]),
        7, _2021q3 * DISTINCTCOUNT(dim_date[Date]),
        8, _2021q2 * DISTINCTCOUNT(dim_date[Date]),
        9, _2021q1 * DISTINCTCOUNT(dim_date[Date]),
        10, CALCULATE([_display_value], DATEADD(dim_date[Date],-2,YEAR), dim_date[Date]<=last_date_yoy_),
        11, CALCULATE([_display_value], DATEADD(dim_date[Date],-7,DAY), dim_date[Date]<=last_date_week_),
        12, CALCULATE([_display_value], DATEADD(dim_date[Date],-1,DAY), dim_date[Date]<=last_date_day_),
        13, CALCULATE([_display_value], DATEADD(dim_date[Date],-3,MONTH), dim_date[Date]<=last_date_qoq_),
        14, _2021jan * DISTINCTCOUNT(dim_date[Date]),
        15, _2021feb * DISTINCTCOUNT(dim_date[Date]),
        BLANK()
    )
